That’s an implementation inconsistency/limitation: the booking record will not reflect additional host destination calendars. However, the claim that this will “orphan” other hosts’ calendar events is not directly verifiable from this diff because other lifecycle operations (update/delete) were also changed to iterate over `_calendar` references, which likely remain the source of truth for managing created events.
